annotations.title: Get full details for a hotel

description: Fetch full details for a single hotel by its VICATOO hotel_id (numeric hid, the hotel_id search_hotels returns, or the slug). Returns name, star rating, REAL guest rating (score/10 + review count — cite it, and call get_hotel_reviews for guest pros/cons before strongly recommending), what the hotel is known for (vibe_tags), location, check-in/out times, headline amenities, images, a description, AND the available rooms cheapest-first — each with photos, a live price (total for the stay and per night), size, view, bed type, meal plan and cancellation. PRICES ARE FOR A STAY: pass check_in, check_out, adults and children_ages (the same values as the guest's search_hotels call) so the prices are for their stay. Without dates the prices are APPROXIMATE, for a default stay the reply names (prices_for.approximate = true) — say so to the guest. When has_video is true, offer the real room-tour video via get_room_video with the returned reel_id.

check_in.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Pass the same stay the guest searched, so the room prices are for it.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency for room prices. Defaults to USD so hotel details match the search-result prices; pass the same currency the guest saw in search.

hotel_id.description: VICATOO hotel id — either the numeric hid (e.g., 7476954) or the slug (e.g., "bentley-hotel-bosphorus-7476954").

lang.description: 2-letter language code for content (en, ar, de, fr, es, ru, etc.).

residency.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of guest residency (same default as search_hotels).

view.description: Optional preferred view family (e.g. "bosphorus", "sea", "garden", "city", "pool"). When the guest arrived from a view-constrained search, pass it so rooms with that view are floated to the top instead of the default cheapest-first ordering.

name: get_hotel_details
title: Get full details for a hotel
